user.title: Welcome to Vision (1/5): the place
user.description:
Vision helps you stay in charge of the screens in one place: phones, tablets, TVs and PCs. Five short steps; everything can be changed later in Configure.

First the name of the place, shown in the apps, the dashboard and notifications. Then, if you like, the words for the two roles.

mots.name: Words for the roles (optional)
mots.description: Default: {defauts}. An empty field keeps the default word; {longueur} characters at most.

personnes.title: People (2/5)
personnes.description:
Who approves or refuses requests? These people will be {decideurs}. The others will be {demandeurs}: their devices are protected, and they can ask for time or access.

The list comes from the people in Home Assistant (Settings → People). Nobody in the list? Carry on: the role can be chosen later, on each person's page.

objectifs.title: Goals (3/5)
objectifs.description:
{erreur}Tick what you want to do. Each goal turns on the useful modules; the module-by-module detail stays in Vision → Settings → Features.

Good to know: "Requests and remote answers" needs schedules or content (there has to be something to ask for).

appareil.title: The first device (4/5)
appareil.description: Which device do you want to link first? Right after, "Add a device" (in Configure) guides you, with the install link and the QR code.

pret.title: All set (5/5)

New device enrollment: **{etat}**.

“Allow for {minutes} min” opens enrollment and closes it again by itself, even if Home Assistant restarts in the meantime. qr.title: 🔳 Create a pairing QR code
qr.description:
The device scans this QR code from the Vision app and pairs by itself. The QR code works only once and expires within a few minutes; it does not contain the enrollment key.

Person: choose now or later. Device: only to **take over** a device that is already enrolled (app reinstalled); otherwise an already enrolled device is refused.

qr_affiche.description:
![Pairing QR code]({image})

In the Vision app on the device: **Scan the Home Assistant QR code**. Valid for {minutes} minutes, only once. Do not leave it where anyone can see it: it can enroll a device.

deverrouillage.title: 🔓 Unlock requests
deverrouillage.description:
{demandes} Pick one, then approve it (shortening the time if you like) or decline it.

**Delivery**: “direct”, the device unlocks by itself; “code”, you read a 6-digit code to the person; “QR”, the person scans the screen.

accueil.title: 👋 Welcome messages
accueil.description:
{erreur}The message shown at the top of the app, on each device, in its language. Write one message per line; the variables below are filled in when the message is shown. Nothing written: “Hello!” (“Good evening!” from 6 pm).

“Depending on the time of day” mode: start a line with `morning:`, `afternoon:`, `evening:` or `night:` (or `matin:`, `apres-midi:`, `soir:`, `nuit:`) to keep it for that time (morning 5 am–12 pm, afternoon 12–6 pm, evening 6–10 pm, night 10 pm–5 am); a line without a prefix is used at any time. “Random” mode: prefixes are ignored.

For experts (Advanced section): a Home Assistant Jinja template replaces the messages, with the same variables, for example `{exemple}`. If it fails, or renders an empty text or more than 200 characters, the normal message is shown.

**Variables** (current value)
{aide}

**Preview** (what is saved)
{apercu}

data_description.meteo: Empty: the first weather entity found.

avance.name: Advanced (for experts)
avance.description: A Home Assistant Jinja template, rendered each time the message is shown.

modules_protections.title: ⚙️ Turn off the protections?
modules_protections.description:
⚠️ Without the anti-bypass protections, a supervised person can uninstall Vision, become an administrator of their PC or open the protected settings, and so lift all the rules. {concernes}: {appareils}.

Only turn them off if you trust everyone who uses these devices.

data.je_comprends: I understand, turn off the protections

entites.title: 🧩 Home Assistant entities
entites.description:
The Home Assistant widgets in the Vision app: each device only sees the entities given to its person (plus its exceptions) and can only use the actions ticked here. Read-only by default; locks and alarms can never be controlled from a device.

{resume}

error.cle_invalide: The key must be 12 to 64 characters, with no spaces, and must not be a published example.
error.code_inconnu: Unknown or expired code: start the request again on the device.
error.qr_impossible: Could not create the QR code (Home Assistant address unknown, or too many QR codes in progress).
error.deverrouillage_demande: This request is no longer pending (already decided, cancelled or expired).
error.deverrouillage_minutes: Invalid time: at most what was asked.
error.biometrie_parent: Biometrics can only be allowed on a device whose role has the “Fingerprint or face” function.
error.role_refuse: Refused: see the message at the top.
error.deverrouillage_deja_vote: You have already approved this request: another person needs to approve it.
error.ajout_pas_encore: Not paired yet. Finish the step on the device, then tap Next again.
error.ajout_expire: Time ran out: here is a new QR code (or a new command).
error.modules_confirmer: Tick the box to confirm, or close this window to keep the protections.
error.confirmer_restauration: Tick the box to confirm: the current configuration will be replaced.
error.sauvegarde_introuvable: This backup no longer exists. Choose another one.
error.sauvegarde_illisible: This backup cannot be read or comes from a newer version of Vision. Nothing was changed.
error.accueil_modele_invalide: The Jinja template is not valid: check its syntax (details at the top of the screen).
error.soutien_vide: Paste the code you received by e-mail.
error.soutien_format: This is not a complete code: check that it was copied in full.
error.soutien_version: This code comes from a newer version of Vision: please update Vision.
error.soutien_signature: This code is not valid (signature rejected). Copy it again from the e-mail.
error.code_different: The two codes are not the same.
error.objectifs_dependances: A goal is missing: see the message at the top.
error.entites_rien_a_piloter: No controllable entity is given to a person or device: choose some entities first (lights, switches, scripts, scenes, buttons, covers, thermostats).

abort.not_loaded: Vision is not loaded: try again in a moment.
abort.sauvegarde_faite: Backup done: {sauvegarde}. It is in the “{dossier}” folder of the Home Assistant configuration.
abort.sauvegarde_restauree: Configuration restored from the backup of {sauvegarde}. The previous state is kept: {avant}.

abort.essai_aucun_android: No Android device in Vision: nothing to set.
abort.soutien_merci: ♥ Thank you for your support! The badge appears on devices at their next check-in.

remettre_a_zero.description: Resets the week's counters (requests, access granted and declined, time added), like the Sunday send.

concentration.name: Focus
concentration.description: For a while (homework), only the chosen apps stay open on the person's devices. Vision, the phone, messages, the clock and the calculator always stay open. With no apps given, Vision reuses the last choice made for this person.

applis.name: Apps kept
applis.description: The names of the apps to keep open, as Vision knows them (“com.google.android.apps.docs”, “word”).

appareils.name: Devices
appareils.description: The names of the devices to target; empty for all of the person's devices.

arreter.name: Stop
arreter.description: Stops the current focus mode instead of starting one.

limiter_temps.name: Limit software time
limiter_temps.description: So many minutes per day for a piece of software or an app, on all of the person's devices. Once the time is used up, it is blocked until the next day. 0 removes the limit.

logiciel.name: Software
logiciel.description: The program name as Vision knows it (“roblox”, “com.supercell.brawlstars”).

partager_appareil.name: Share a device
partager_appareil.description: Says who else a device belongs to besides its main person. Sharing moves no rules; it says whose list the device appears in and who can get time on it. With no person and without “all devices”, the device is no longer shared.

pc.name: Device
pc.description: Device name as shown in Home Assistant.

tout_le_monde.name: All devices
tout_le_monde.description: The device belongs to everyone (the living room TV).

valider_appairage.name: Approve a pairing
valider_appairage.description: Approves the request from the device showing this code (QR pairing). It gets its access; with no person chosen here, it stays without a person. Administrators only.

code.name: Code
code.description: The short code shown on the device.

refuser_appairage.name: Decline a pairing
refuser_appairage.description: Declines the request from the device showing this code. Administrators only.

code.name: Code
code.description: The short code shown on the device.

envoyer.name: Send a rich message
envoyer.description: Text, image, sound or video on a TV or PC, placed where you want, optionally blocking, with a receipt (pc_parental_message event). Administrators only. See docs/messages.md.

pc.name: Device
pc.description: Device name as shown in Home Assistant.

tag.name: Label
tag.description: Targets all devices with this Home Assistant label.

type.name: Type
type.description: Worked out from the media if missing.

message.name: Message
message.description: The text, or the caption of a media item.

media.name: Media
media.description: A local Home Assistant media item (/media folder).

son.name: Sound
son.description: Sound Windows plays when the message arrives.

bloquant.name: Blocking
bloquant.description: No; until read = full screen until “I've read it”; until released = full screen until someone lifts it with the management code, or an administrator lifts it (pc_parental.liberer_message…).

limite.name: Safety limit
limite.description: Only for blocking until released; after this, it lifts by itself (logged).

expire.name: Expiry
expire.description: A message not delivered or not read expires after this.

liberer_message.name: Release a blocking message
liberer_message.description: Lifts a message blocking until released on a device (at the next check-in). Administrators only.

pc.name: Device
pc.description: Device name as shown in Home Assistant.

id.name: Message
id.description: Its number; with no number, all of the device's blocking messages.

approuver_deverrouillage.name: Approve an unlock
approuver_deverrouillage.description: Approves a device's unlock request (the action and time asked for, or less). Direct delivery (the device gets it by itself), by code (returned) or by QR code (returned). Administrators only.

remise.name: Delivery
remise.description: How the person gets the unlock.

refuser_deverrouillage.name: Decline an unlock
refuser_deverrouillage.description: Declines the unlock request. Administrators only.

nouvelle_cle_deverrouillage.name: New unlock key
nouvelle_cle_deverrouillage.description: Replaces the key that signs unlock approvals; those in progress no longer work. Devices get the new key at their next check-in. Administrators only.

deverrouiller_appareil.name: Unlock a device
deverrouiller_appareil.description: Unlocks a device right away, without any request from it: full access (Android settings, installs, developer options) for 15, 30 or 60 min, then it locks again by itself. Every responsible person is notified. Administrators only.

pc.name: Device
pc.description: The device to unlock (its Vision identifier).

pause_generale.name: Block everything
pause_generale.description: Blocks all supervised devices at once for a while; the devices of the people who decide stay open. “Allow again” allows them before the end. Administrators only.

fin_pause_generale.name: Allow again
fin_pause_generale.description: Allows again the devices that “Block everything” was holding: they go back to their schedule. A manual block from before is kept. Administrators only.

musique_vider_suite.name: Music — clear the queue
musique_vider_suite.description: Removes every track after the current one from the chosen speaker's Music Assistant queue (the current track keeps playing) and turns off automatic additions. Administrators only.

entity_id.name: Speaker
entity_id.description: The Music Assistant player whose queue is cleared.

reveil_creer.name: Alarm — create
reveil_creer.description: Creates an alarm for a Requester. It is scheduled on their devices, which ring by themselves even if Home Assistant or the network is down. Returns the alarm id. Requires the « Alarm » module.

demandeur.name: Requester
demandeur.description: The person to wake up (person.*, or their name).

type.name: Trigger
type.description: hebdo (time + days), ponctuel (one date), entite (time read from a timestamp entity), modele (template rendering a date and time), manuel (only rings on command).

jours.name: Days
jours.description: For hebdo (0 = Monday … 6 = Sunday, or mon, tue…). Default Monday to Friday.

attribut.name: Attribute
attribut.description: Read this attribute instead of the state (optional).

modele.name: Template
modele.description: For modele; must render a date and time.

decalage.name: Offset
decalage.description: Minutes added to the time read (negative = earlier), for entite and modele.

bornes.name: Bounds
bornes.description: Range in which the computed time is accepted, [min, max] (default 05:00 – 10:00).

repli.name: Fallback time
repli.description: Used when the computed time is missing or out of bounds. Without a fallback, the occurrence is skipped and vision_reveil_echec is fired.

appareils.name: Devices
appareils.description: Vision devices of the Requester that ring (name or id). Default: their phones and tablets.

source.name: Source
source.description: sonnerie (ringtone), url (radio, podcast, stream), ma (Music Assistant), video. The local ringtone stays the fallback.

uri.name: Address or media
uri.description: http(s) address of the stream, or Music Assistant track / playlist / radio.

lecteur.name: Music Assistant player
lecteur.description: Speaker that plays the Music Assistant source (optional).

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: (debut: %, fin: %, montee_s: seconds) — default 10 → 60 % over 180 s.

impose.name: Imposed
impose.description: The Requester can neither change nor disable it (they can snooze and stop).

allumer_tv.name: Turn on the TV
allumer_tv.description: Use the power-on method chosen for the targeted TVs.

actif.name: Enabled
actif.description: A disabled alarm is armed on no device.

reveil_modifier.name: Alarm — modify
reveil_modifier.description: Modifies an alarm; only the given fields change. Same fields as « Alarm — create ».

reveil.name: Alarm
reveil.description: Id, alarm entity (switch.vision_reveil_…) or exact name.

demandeur.name: Requester
demandeur.description: Change the Requester (their devices do not follow).

type.name: Trigger
type.description: hebdo (time + days), ponctuel (one date), entite (time read from a timestamp entity), modele (template rendering a date and time), manuel (only rings on command).

jours.name: Days
jours.description: For hebdo (0 = Monday … 6 = Sunday, or mon, tue…). Default Monday to Friday.

attribut.name: Attribute
attribut.description: Read this attribute instead of the state (optional).

modele.name: Template
modele.description: For modele; must render a date and time.

decalage.name: Offset
decalage.description: Minutes added to the time read (negative = earlier), for entite and modele.

bornes.name: Bounds
bornes.description: Range in which the computed time is accepted, [min, max] (default 05:00 – 10:00).

repli.name: Fallback time
repli.description: Used when the computed time is missing or out of bounds. Without a fallback, the occurrence is skipped and vision_reveil_echec is fired.

appareils.name: Devices
appareils.description: Vision devices of the Requester that ring (name or id). Default: their phones and tablets.

source.name: Source
source.description: sonnerie (ringtone), url (radio, podcast, stream), ma (Music Assistant), video. The local ringtone stays the fallback.

uri.name: Address or media
uri.description: http(s) address of the stream, or Music Assistant track / playlist / radio.

lecteur.name: Music Assistant player
lecteur.description: Speaker that plays the Music Assistant source (optional).

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: (debut: %, fin: %, montee_s: seconds) — default 10 → 60 % over 180 s.

impose.name: Imposed
impose.description: The Requester can neither change nor disable it (they can snooze and stop).

allumer_tv.name: Turn on the TV
allumer_tv.description: Use the power-on method chosen for the targeted TVs.

actif.name: Enabled
actif.description: A disabled alarm is armed on no device.

reveil.name: Alarm
reveil.description: Id, alarm entity (switch.vision_reveil_…) or exact name.

reveil_desactiver.name: Alarm — disable
reveil_desactiver.description: Disables an alarm; its devices disarm it at their next poll.

reveil.name: Alarm
reveil.description: Id, alarm entity (switch.vision_reveil_…) or exact name.

reveil_sauter.name: Alarm — skip an occurrence
reveil_sauter.description: Cancels a single occurrence (default: the next one) without changing the alarm. « Alarm — resume » undoes it.

reveil.name: Alarm
reveil.description: Id, alarm entity (switch.vision_reveil_…) or exact name.

date.name: Date
date.description: The date to skip (default: the next occurrence).

reveil_reprendre.name: Alarm — resume an occurrence
reveil_reprendre.description: Undoes the skip of a date (default: the first skipped date).

reveil.name: Alarm
reveil.description: Id, alarm entity (switch.vision_reveil_…) or exact name.

reveil_sonner.name: Alarm — ring now
reveil_sonner.description: Rings right away, as soon as the devices poll (on a phone in deep sleep, without a guaranteed delay). Give an alarm, or a Requester.

reveil.name: Alarm
reveil.description: Id, alarm entity (switch.vision_reveil_…) or exact name.

demandeur.name: Requester
demandeur.description: Without an alarm, the person whose devices ring.

appareils.name: Devices
appareils.description: Default: the alarm's devices, or the Requester's phones and tablets.

source.name: Source
source.description: sonnerie (ringtone), url (radio, podcast, stream), ma (Music Assistant), video. The local ringtone stays the fallback.

uri.name: Address or media
uri.description: http(s) address of the stream, or Music Assistant track / playlist / radio.

lecteur.name: Music Assistant player
lecteur.description: Speaker that plays the Music Assistant source (optional).

reveil_reporter.name: Alarm — snooze
reveil_reporter.description: Snoozes the ringing alarm on all its devices.

reveil.name: Alarm
reveil.description: Id, alarm entity (switch.vision_reveil_…) or exact name.

reveil_arreter.name: Alarm — stop
reveil_arreter.description: Stops the ringing on all devices (one alarm, or all alarms of a Requester).

reveil.name: Alarm
reveil.description: Id, alarm entity (switch.vision_reveil_…) or exact name.

demandeur.name: Requester
demandeur.description: Without an alarm, the person whose devices ring.

reveil_supprimer.name: Alarm — delete
reveil_supprimer.description: Deletes an alarm, its entities and its Home Assistant device.

reveil.name: Alarm
reveil.description: Id, alarm entity (switch.vision_reveil_…) or exact name.

reveil_lister.name: Alarm — list
reveil_lister.description: Returns the visible alarms (next occurrence, state, synchronised devices) and the module settings.

reveil_regler.name: Alarm — module settings
reveil_regler.description: Place settings for the Alarm module. Administrators and automations only.

arret_auto_min.name: Auto stop
arret_auto_min.description: The device stops by itself after this delay (default 30 min).

fenetre_avant_min.name: Window before
fenetre_avant_min.description: binary_sensor.vision_fenetre_reveil turns on this long before the first occurrence (default 60 min).

fenetre_apres_min.name: Window after
fenetre_apres_min.description: And turns off this long after the last one (default 30 min).

synchro_avant_min.name: Sync check
synchro_avant_min.description: Delay before the time when an unsynchronised device is reported (default 10 min).

ordre_ttl_min.name: « Ring » order validity
ordre_ttl_min.description: An older « ring » order is no longer delivered (default 15 min).

horizon_h.name: Horizon
horizon_h.description: Hours of occurrences sent in advance to devices (default 48 h).

reveil_installer_modeles.name: Alarm — install the templates
reveil_installer_modeles.description: Places the blueprints shipped with the module (for example « Wake-up on school days ») in the Home Assistant blueprints folder (automations). An existing copy is never overwritten. Administrators only.

reprise_autorisations.name: Permissions takeover
reprise_autorisations.description: New permission rules (for a while, exception, always available): simulate what changes, apply after review, or roll back.

action.name: Action
action.description: Simulate: report without changing anything. Apply: the new decision engine applies (the previous state is saved). Cancel: back to the previous engine.

ecran_regler.name: Screen – device settings
ecran_regler.description: Screen of one device (administrators and automations only). Defaults change nothing.

pc.name: Device
pc.description: Name of the device.

veille_vision.name: Vision screensaver
veille_vision.description: Lets Vision's screensaver (clock, photos, playlist) start on this device.

garder_allume.name: Keep the screen on
garder_allume.description: Vision's home screen keeps the Android screen from going to sleep.

veille_regler.name: Screensaver — device options
veille_regler.description: Options of the screensaver of one device (administrators and automations only). The device applies the most recent setting, from Home Assistant or from the TV itself.

pc.name: Device
pc.description: Name of the device.

lecteur.name: Music player banner
lecteur.description: Shows the cover, title, artist and play/pause of the music of this device while it plays (off by default).

qr.name: Guests' QR code
qr.description: Corner of the guests' QR code (party mode open): haut_gauche (top left), haut_droite (top right), bas_gauche (bottom left), bas_droite (bottom right) or cache (hidden). Bottom right by default.

logo.name: Vision logo
logo.description: Corner of the Vision eye: same values; bottom left (its usual place) by default. The QR code and the logo never share a corner.

qr_taille.name: Guests' QR code size
qr_taille.description: petit (small, scan up close ≈ 1 m, default), moyen (medium, ≈ 1.5 m) or grand (large, ≈ 2 m). Also used by the music player.

musique_regler.name: Music — sound from other apps
musique_regler.description: What Vision's music does on a device when another app plays sound (administrators and automations only). The device applies the most recent setting, from Home Assistant or from the TV itself.

pc.name: Device
pc.description: Name of the device.

focus.name: Pause the music
focus.description: toujours (default): pause as soon as another app plays sound; applis: only for the apps in the list; jamais: the music keeps playing. Switching to a TV input (HDMI, live TV) counts as another app.

applis.name: Apps that pause the music
applis.description: Android package names (for example com.google.android.youtube.tv), for “applis”. vision.entrees_tele stands for the TV inputs (HDMI, live TV).

reprise.name: Resume automatically
reprise.description: The music starts again by itself when the other sound stops (off by default).

accueil_regler.name: Home screen — apps list
accueil_regler.description: Show or hide the apps list on an Android device's home screen (administrators and automations only). Hidden, the home screen shows only the widgets (dashboard); a long press on the time still opens the settings, behind the code or fingerprint. The device applies the most recent setting, from Home Assistant or from the device itself.

pc.name: Device
pc.description: Name of the device.

liste_applis.name: Show the apps list
liste_applis.description: On (default): the apps list is shown. Off: only the widgets (the list stays if the home screen has no widget).

widget_regler.name: Widget — line under the value
widget_regler.description: Sets the widget of an entity on every device (administrators and automations only): the line written under the value, its name and its icon. Same as the Widgets HA card.

entite.name: Widget entity
entite.description: The entity the widget shows (for example input_number.setpoint).

ligne.name: Line under the value
ligne.description: Another entity whose state is written under the value (for example sensor.heating_mode). Empty: no line.

son_regler.name: Sound level — device settings
son_regler.description: Settings of the sound measurement on one device (administrators and automations only). Only a number leaves the device: no audio is recorded or sent.

pc.name: Device
pc.description: Name of the device.

actif.name: Measure on this device
actif.description: Turns the microphone measurement on or off for this device.

seuil_db.name: Threshold
seuil_db.description: Relative level (0 to 100) above which the room counts as too noisy.

sensibilite_s.name: Sensitivity
sensibilite_s.description: Seconds above the threshold before an alert (shorter peaks are ignored).

alertes_avant_coupure.name: Alerts before cut-off
alertes_avant_coupure.description: The device is cut off at this alert; 0 = alerts only.

coupure_min.name: Cut-off duration
coupure_min.description: How long the device stays closed.

calme_min.name: Calm reset
calme_min.description: Minutes without noise before the alert count goes back to zero.

calibration_db.name: Calibration
calibration_db.description: Added to the device measurement (microphones differ).

plages.name: Active time ranges
plages.description: List of (debut, fin) in HH:MM; empty = all day.

seuil_nuit_db.name: Night threshold
seuil_nuit_db.description: Relative level (0 to 100) at night: the device's “Lock the session” ranges, otherwise the fallback range.

nuit.name: Definition of night
nuit.description: “plages”: the device's schedule; “heures”: the fallback range below.

nuit_debut.name: Night start (fallback)
nuit_debut.description: HH:MM, used without a session range or when nuit = heures.

repos_min.name: Delay between two alerts
repos_min.description: Minimum minutes between two counted alerts.

ferme_apres_min.name: Escalation window
ferme_apres_min.description: One more alert within this delay: firm message, then the responsible people are notified.

prevenir_responsable.name: Notify the responsible people
prevenir_responsable.description: On the third close alert, through their “alerts” channels.

micro_fige_s.name: Frozen microphone delay
micro_fige_s.description: A microphone whose level does not change for this many seconds is left out of the average.

micro_plancher_dbfs.name: Microphone floor
micro_plancher_dbfs.description: A microphone quieter than this (dBFS, before calibration) picks up nothing and counts as off.

reagir.name: React to noise
reagir.description: On: graduated messages, people in charge notified, cut-off. Off: measure only.

micros_exclus.name: Ignored microphones
micros_exclus.description: Parts of microphone names left out of the level (e.g. a headset close to the mouth).

seuil_mode.name: Threshold mode
seuil_mode.description: General: one threshold all day. Per time slot: each Vision time slot can have its own; the strictest active one applies, otherwise the general one.

seuil_dbfs.name: General threshold (dBFS)
seuil_dbfs.description: Maximum allowed level, in dBFS (0 = microphone full scale).

marge_plancher_db.name: General threshold above the floor
marge_plancher_db.description: The general threshold as N dB above the room floor (measured over 24 h, or entered).

seuils_plages.name: Thresholds per time slot
seuils_plages.description: List of plage: name or id, seuil_dbfs or marge_plancher_db.

plage_effacer.name: Clear time slot thresholds
plage_effacer.description: These time slots follow the general threshold again.

plancher_dbfs.name: Room floor (dBFS)
plancher_dbfs.description: Entered by hand; it replaces the floor measured over 24 h.

plancher_auto.name: Measured floor
plancher_auto.description: Forget the entered floor and use the one measured over 24 h.

retirer_ce_logiciel_de_la_liste.name: Remove this software from the list

retirer_ce_site_de_la_liste.name: Remove this site from the list

reveil_entite.message: An « entity » alarm needs a timestamp entity.

reveil_modele.message: A « template » alarm needs a template.

reveil_source_uri.message: This source needs an address or a media.

reveil_source_lecteur.message: The player must be a media_player entity: {valeur}.

reveil_cible.message: Give an alarm or a Requester.

adresse_deja_epargnee.message: “{adresse}” is already spared on this device.

adresse_http.message: The address must start with http:// or https://.

adresse_manquante.message: Choose an address that was seen, or type it in “Address to spare”.

adresse_pas_epargnee.message: “{adresse}” was not spared on this device.

ajout_vide.message: First type a name in “Site or software to add”.

appareil_cible_manquant.message: First choose a device in “Selected device”.

element_constate.message: “{nom}” was not added by hand: it was seen on a computer.

element_manquant.message: First choose an item in the list.

message_en_attente.message: Message queued, but these devices are not responding: {appareils}. It will show when they are back, within 15 minutes.

message_vide.message: First write a message in “Message to send”.

plage_a_supprimer_manquante.message: Choose the time slot to delete in the list.

plage_debut_egal_fin.message: The start and end of a time slot must be different.

plage_disparue.message: This time slot no longer exists.

plage_etiquettes_manquantes.message: Name at least one category in “Categories to block”, or choose “Lock the session”.

plage_etiquettes_vides.message: This time slot blocks categories: emptying the list would block nothing. Switch it back to “Lock the session” first, or delete it.

plage_sans_etiquette.message: First name the categories for this time slot: a time slot that blocks no category blocks nothing.

plage_sans_jour.message: A time slot with no days never applies. To pause it, turn off its switch.

programme_intouchable.message: “{programme}” keeps Windows or Vision running: blocking it would break the computer without protecting anyone.

programme_manquant.message: First choose a program in “Opened by”. The list stays empty until a connection is caught while it is open: a site opened and closed between two check-ins leaves no trace of who opened it.

site_manquant.message: First choose a site in the list.

tableau_echec.message: The dashboard could not be created. Check the Home Assistant log.

virustotal_sans_cle.message: First enter your key in “VirusTotal key”. You can create one on virustotal.com, in your profile.
